# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 02, Serye ng 2023 — Prescribing Guidelines and Policies on the Management and Use of Local Government Rescue Ambulances

## Summary

This ordinance establishes comprehensive rules and policies governing the management and use of rescue ambulances owned by the [[Local Government of Pitogo]]. It references [[RA 10121]] (Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act) and provides that not more than 5% of the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (LDRRM) Fund may be used for ambulance operations. Of the LDRRM Fund, 70% is allocated for disaster response and 30% for disaster preparedness programs. The ordinance also covers rescue supplies, equipment, post-disaster operations, and insurance premiums.

## Key Provisions

- Establishes guidelines for the proper management and deployment of municipal rescue ambulances.
- Limits the use of LDRRM Fund for ambulance operations to not more than 5% of the total fund.
- Allocates LDRRM Fund usage: 70% for disaster response, 30% for disaster preparedness programs.
- Covers maintenance of rescue supplies, equipment, and post-disaster operational protocols.
- Requires insurance coverage for rescue ambulance units and personnel.
- References [[RA 10121]] on Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management.

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General Welfare Clause, authorizing LGUs to undertake measures for the health, safety, and welfare of constituents.
- [[Sec-17-RA7160]] — Basic Services and Facilities, mandating LGUs to provide essential public services including health and safety services.
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, and functions of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- [[RA 10121]] — Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act, governing the LDRRM Fund and its utilization.
